messages:
taylor: Morning team — async standup for pipeline. TL;DR: 3 demo slots this week, one security gating item on NovaHealth.

ria: Got it. Yesterday: ran through demo runbook with eng, found the customer needs BYOK + audit logs.

omar: Blocker: NovaHealth wants HSM integration diagram + timeline. Also they asked for on-prem deployment checklist.

sasha: Today: I'll pull together the HSM integration diagram and a short one-pager for the on-prem checklist. ETA EOD.

taylor: Thanks. Ria — can you surface the audit log retention ask to eng-ops? Need to confirm we can meet 7y retention in Dedicated.

ria: pinging @eng-ops via DM now. Also, NovaHealth asked about SSO + SCIM. Do we have the SCIM mapping docs?

omar: We have a draft SCIM mapping in Confluence, but ok to paste quick snippet here:
```
SCIM group -> Redwood team
scim:groups.displayName = team.name
attributes: email, name, role
```

sasha: Helpful. For the HSM diagram I need KMS provider name and whether they'll do key rotation weekly or monthly. NovaHealth's security lead said weekly.

taylor: Noted. Also FYI we have a legal NDA template update in review — might shift timelines by 2 days.

pipeline-bot: :bell: Demo calendar updated: 3 slots booked (Wed 10:00am, Thu 2:30pm, Fri 9:00am).

ria: Quick ask: Who can join the Thu 2:30 PM call as technical lead? Prefer someone who knows Dedicated autoscale and network setup.

omar: I can take Thu 2:30. Will prep a 10-min network diagram and answer KMS/HSM questions.

sasha: I'll join Fri 9:00 to cover rollout/rollbacks and can run through the canary policy examples.

taylor: Blockers summary: NovaHealth security wants HSM design + SCIM + audit-retention confirmation + NDA signoff. Owners: HSM/SCIM/docs -> sasha/omar; audit retention -> ria + eng-ops; NDA -> legal (taylor following).

ria: Quick code/snippet for the demo environment binding (for the runbook):
```
# bind demo to dedicated
redwood deploy --env demo --capacity dedicated --autoscale-min 2 --autoscale-max 8
```

omar: One more: NovaHealth asked whether we support prefix KV cache eviction policies for long conversations. Eng says yes — default TTL is 24h, we can bump per-customer.

taylor: Good. Can someone confirm adjustable TTLs in writing before Thu? That will be a key ask.

sasha: Confirming — will get written confirmation from infra team and paste here by EOD.

ria: Anything else from pipeline?

taylor: Quick FYI — open deal with KestrelHealth moving to contract phase, legal asked for SOC2 attestation doc. I uploaded it to the deal record.

ria: Noted. I'll follow up with legal to speed.

pipeline-bot: :white_check_mark: Actions added to deal records: HSM diagram (sasha), SCIM mapping (omar), audit retention confirmation (ria), NDA followup (taylor).

sasha: That's it from me. Short and sharp today. :thumbsup:

omar: Same. See you on Thu.

taylor: Thanks all — drop any quick updates here. If anything blocks the Thu tech lead slot, flag ASAP.
